Class Armes

java.lang.Object
entities.equipements.Equipements
entities.equipements.armes.Armes
Direct Known Subclasses:
BouclierBois, EpeeBois
public abstract class Armes extends Equipements
Abstract class representing a weapon equipment. Extends the generic Equipements class by adding weapon-specific attributes such as range.

    • Armes

      public Armes(GamePanel gp, boolean drop, String name, int unite, List<String> spritePath, boolean isMelee, int range, ArrayList<Integer> position)
      Constructs a new weapon.
      Parameters:
      gp - Reference to the GamePanel.
      drop - Whether the weapon is dropped on the ground.
      name - Name of the weapon.
      unite - Quantity or damage unit depending on game logic.
      spritePath - Paths to weapon sprites.
      isMelee - Indicates if the weapon is melee (unused logically here).
      range - Effective range of the weapon.
      position - Position of the weapon in the world.
